MHPCO claim office quotes 3 moonstones with a base premium of 60 G (block applies per component type) -- 71 G total
MHPCO claim office adds a 50 % curse surcharge to the affected item's base premium -- cursed sword 165 G

MHPCO claim office adds both curse and high-enchantment surcharges to a cursed sword with enchantment 5 -- 195 G

MHPCO claim office applies no loyalty discount at 1 year with MHPCO -- sword 115 G
MHPCO claim office applies the 10 % first-insurance surcharge to the policy base premium -- sword + amulet: 160 G base + 16 G + 5 G fee = 181 G
MHPCO claim office applies the 15 % follow-up discount to every quote after the customer's first quote -- 3-year customer's second contract for a cursed sword (enchantment 7) = 160 G
MHPCO claim office applies no follow-up discount to the customer's first quote -- sword at 3 years = 95 G
MHPCO claim office rounds a premium of 197.5 G up to 198 G (in the MHPCO's favour) -- 7 runes
MHPCO claim office keeps intermediate amounts as fractions and rounds only the final premium -- 1 rune: 25 + 2.5 + 5 = 32.5 -> 33 G

MHPCO claim office quotes a 3-year customer's second contract for a cursed sword (enchantment 7) as 160 G

MHPCO claim office pays out 100 G for a rune with 200 G damage (no enchantment or material, so no special clause)
MHPCO claim office reports the remaining cap after a claim (sword policy, cap 2000 G, payout 400 G -> 1600 G remaining)
MHPCO claim office pays out 400 G for a steel sword with enchantment 9 and 1000 G damage (50 % clause, then deductible)
MHPCO claim office pays out 400 G for a dragon-material sword with enchantment exactly 8 and 1000 G damage
MHPCO claim office pays out 700 G for a dragon-material sword with enchantment 5 and 800 G damage (full reimbursement, then deductible)
MHPCO claim office pays out 400 G for a dragon-material sword with enchantment 9 and 1000 G damage (50 % rule wins)
MHPCO claim office applies the 100 G deductible once per damaged item -- sword 500 G + amulet 300 G -> payout 600 G
MHPCO claim office rounds a payout of 350.5 G down to 350 G (in the MHPCO's favour) -- enchantment 9 sword, 901 G damage
